tickerText: [TENNIS] Top seed Alexander Zverev fell to Tallon Griekspoor 6-7, 6-2, 6-4 in Montreal as Caty McNally upset Wimbledon champ Linda Noskova 7-6, 6-1 in Toronto • [SQUASH] Egypt's Salman Khalil swept Nasir Iqbal 14-12, 11-3, 13-11 to claim his maiden PSA World Event title at the PN Fleet Club Open in Karachi • [BADMINTON] BWF World Championships draw pits India's Ayush Shetty against defending champion Shi Yu Qi in a blockbuster New Delhi opener August 17–23 • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Tour launches unified World Pickleball Rankings for 2026–27, weighting gender doubles, mixed, and singles into one global leaderboard • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama round of 16 begins without China's Wang Chuqin as Sreeja Akula eyes a quarterfinal run at the $500K BUNTAI event

newsItems.title: Zverev, Noskova Exit Canadian Open
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Alexander Zverev lost to Tallon Griekspoor in Montreal while Caty McNally upset Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova 7-6, 6-1 in Toronto.

newsItems.title: Khalil Claims Karachi Crown
newsItems.excerpt: Egypt's Salman Khalil swept Pakistan's Nasir Iqbal 14-12, 11-3, 13-11 to win his first PSA World Event title at the PN Fleet Club Open.

newsItems.title: Shetty Draws Shi in Worlds Opener
newsItems.excerpt: BWF World Championships draw sets up a first-round rematch between India's Ayush Shetty and defending champion Shi Yu Qi in New Delhi.

newsItems.title: PPA Debuts World Rankings
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour unveiled World Pickleball Rankings — a unified global leaderboard combining gender doubles, mixed, and singles results.
